text: ひとも　ポケモンも　たたかい　きたえれば　どこまでも　つよくなる！

structure.jp: ひとも　ポケモンも
たたかい　きたえれば
どこまでも　つよくなる！

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if'. きたえれば = 'if they train'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く and adding なる means 'become' that way. つよくなる = 'become strong'.

patterns.name: 〜も〜も
patterns.span: ひとも　ポケモンも
patterns.explanation: も after each of two things means 'both ... and'. ひとも　ポケモンも = 'both people and Pokémon'.
